name: hYYa Footprint Inspector
subtitle: Privacy Checkup & Tracking Fix
promotionalText: Free, open-source privacy check. See what any app can learn about your phone, tablet or computer, then fix it. Nothing leaves your device: no account, no ads.
description:
Every app on your device can quietly read details that, together, can identify you. hYYa Footprint Inspector shows you exactly what they can see, and how to fix it.

Run a privacy checkup in seconds: the device details any app reads without asking, what each permission really hands over, and which sensitive apps can be detected. Each finding comes with a calm explanation and a fix: one tap, a jump to the right Settings screen, or a few simple steps.

Why it matters: details like when your device was set up, when it last restarted, your free space to the byte, your headphones' name, your languages and keyboards look harmless one by one. Combined, they work as a device fingerprint that can recognise you across apps.

WHAT YOU GET
• A calm footprint score out of 100 that counts only what you can change.
• Every clue explained: what an app learns, why the system allows it, and how long it lasts.
• A fix for each one, in a few simple steps, or an honest "only Apple can fix this".
• Before and after: scan again and see what changed.

WHAT APPS SEE ONCE YOU SAY YES
Tap any permission to see exactly what an app gets from it: Location, Photos, Contacts, Calendars, Bluetooth, Local Network, Motion, Camera and more. The app asks only when you tap, and shows counts and summaries, never your contacts' names or event titles.

WHICH APPS GIVE YOU AWAY
No app can list everything you've installed, but any app can ask about specific apps, one by one. Choose the kinds of apps to check (dating, faith, health, VPN, messaging, crypto and more) and see what any app could find, with practical advice on what to do. Results are hidden until you tap, cleared when you leave, and never saved.

A GUIDED PERMISSION CHECK-UP
The system never tells one app which other apps can reach your Health data, location or photos. Only Settings knows. The check-up walks you through it, one area at a time.

KEEP TRACK
• Scan history kept only on this device, never in backups.
• A scoreboard showing what Apple has fixed and what is still open.
• A shareable card with your score, and none of your personal details.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Nothing leaves your device. No account, no server, no analytics, no ads.
• Free. No in-app purchases, no subscription.
• Open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

Meet the detective: he lives on every page, leans when you tilt your device, and has a tip if you tap him.

hYYa Footprint Inspector is part of the hYYa family of privacy-first apps.
